$comment: Source scope of package fr/pf-af (wave 1, CNAF-PFAF + FINISH DOM transfer D-73): 15 CSS articles, registry cut 2026-10-06. D755-5-1: current VIGUEUR version alineas from the registry (dump XML); predecessor out of window, not pinned. Bytes: alineas of the registry (.scratch/reg-css.json, DILA LEGI mirror) for current versions; full version XML from the mirror dump for the two superseded versions whose text the reform pairs require (R521-1 2008-2026 with 14 ans; D521-3 2015-2021 with the arrete mechanism in III). Pre-2021 text of L521-2 (ordonnance 2019-950 wording) is not in the mirror (increments only since 07.2025): declared gap, see sources/articles.json. BMAF euro figures and yearly applicable plafond values are published by DSS/2B/2026/46 and DSS/2B/2025/177, pinned in fr.css.revalorisation (phase W0-06). CNAF letter LR-2026-051 (application dates and examples of the 14->18 reform) is pinned in this package (sources/cnaf-lr-2026-051.pdf/.txt). The 2026-138 decree text itself is NOT pinned (owner input D-Q4).

R521-1.reason: 14-ans age rule for the pre-2026-03-01 edition pair (decree 2026-138 reform)

D521-3.reason: same I/II figures, III with the arrete mechanism (removed by decree 2021-1955)
